chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
"Do not perform salat (prayer) behind one who testifies against you with kufr (disbelief), nor behind one against whom you have testified with kufr (disbelief)."

key_terms.بِالْكُفْرِ: with kufr, i.e. declaring someone to be an unbeliever
key_terms.خَلْفَ: behind, meaning under the leadership of an Imam in congregational prayer

ai.seo_question: Can you perform salat (prayer) behind someone who considers you a kāfir, or whom you consider a kāfir?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding congregational salat (prayer), forbidding prayer behind someone where there is mutual attribution of kufr (disbelief). It reflects the seriousness of doctrinal rupture and its effect on the validity or propriety of shared worship leadership.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1114 - Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Halabi narrated from him (as) that He said:
"Do not pray behind someone who declares you to be an unbeliever (kafir), and do not pray behind someone whom you have declared to be an unbeliever."
